features.title: Built for durability and modern living
features.text: The Encardo Annexe is crafted with a robust rubberwood frame that ensures long-lasting strength while maintaining a sleek, contemporary look.

features.title: Easy-to-clean leatherette upholstery
features.text: Its leatherette upholstery is not only stylish but also simple to wipe clean, making it perfect for busy homes or those who love low-maintenance furniture.

features.title: Designed for relaxation with soft cushioning
features.text: The high backrest and soft foam cushioning provide excellent support for your head, shoulders, and back, making it ideal for reading or unwinding.

features.title: Elegant stitching that adds character
features.text: Subtle stitching details elevate the overall design, giving the sofa a polished, refined appearance.

features.title: Compact size that fits anywhere
features.text: The compact design is perfect for small spaces like bedrooms, corners, or apartments where every inch of space counts.
